description: Source code for Renesas SmartBond TRNG entropy driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing hardware entropy collection via TRNG hardware, with interrupt handling and buffer management.

methods.name: trng_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the TRNG hardware clock and control register.

methods.name: trng_available
methods.description: Checks if TRNG FIFO has available data.

methods.name: trng_fifo_read
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit word from the TRNG FIFO address.

methods.name: random_word_get
methods.description: Retrieves a 4-byte random word from TRNG FIFO if available.

methods.name: rng_pool_get
methods.description: Retrieves bytes from the RNG pool buffer.

methods.name: rng_pool_put
methods.description: Puts a byte into the RNG pool buffer.

methods.name: rng_pool_put_bytes
methods.description: Puts multiple bytes into the RNG pool buffer.

methods.name: smartbond_trng_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for handling TRNG data ready events.

methods.name: entropy_smartbond_get_entropy
methods.description: Provides entropy data to consumers, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: entropy_smartbond_get_entropy_isr
methods.description: Provides entropy data via ISR, with busy wait option.

methods.name: entropy_smartbond_init
methods.description: Initializes the entropy driver, sets up IRQ, and enables TRNG.
